pm_exper_user_447_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: Is there anything I should ask my doctor about at my next checkup?
pm_exper_user_447_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Because you play recreational softball, at your next checkup ask about baseline diabetes screening (HbA1c, fasting glucose or an OGTT), a lipid panel, blood pressure, and weight/BMI. Also discuss lifestyle counseling or referral to a dietitian, whether early preventive measures or metformin are appropriate, and how often to repeat screening.
(b) Because you have a maternal family history of type 2 diabetes, at your next checkup ask about baseline diabetes screening (HbA1c, fasting glucose or an OGTT), a lipid panel, blood pressure, and weight/BMI. Also discuss lifestyle counseling or referral to a dietitian, whether early preventive measures or metformin are appropriate, and how often to repeat screening.
(c) Because you frequently cook and eat traditional Mexican dishes, at your next checkup ask about baseline diabetes screening (HbA1c, fasting glucose or an OGTT), a lipid panel, blood pressure, and weight/BMI. Also discuss lifestyle counseling or referral to a dietitian, whether early preventive measures or metformin are appropriate, and how often to repeat screening.
(d) Because this is a routine preventive visit, at your next checkup ask about baseline diabetes screening (HbA1c, fasting glucose or an OGTT), a lipid panel, blood pressure, and weight/BMI. Also discuss lifestyle counseling or referral to a dietitian, whether early preventive measures or metformin are appropriate, and how often to repeat screening.
